Hansen held 2.00 million shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $338.46M, down from 3.40M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Valiant Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc (Call) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $823.61 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.16% or $1.9 $162.32. About 35.66 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
